same_surface_weight.logging: both branches log the unweighted same-surface loss for B and C; only the candidate branch applies the weight

postcheck_scope_at_launch.policy: after 80 optics, report each eligible category and mark unavailable categories as missing

benchmark.scope: 500 steps per branch in each compared mode

1a_start.decision_metric: median per-scene/direction same-surface edge absolute p95, 0–2 px

reference_refresh.pool: all rendered-and-F2-complete training scenes available at refresh
measures: actual B L_bokeh batch fraction, by arm

B_optical_rollout_update.postcheck: after the 80 hard scenes are complete, independent of the remainder

ema.query_pair_protocol: P2 f/1.4。每个 case 固定权重、可见层、实际焦点、F2 背景、光圈偏移和评分掩码，关 Query 只移除第二遍环带隐藏层。阶段 1 使用固定可见层，未启用第一遍边界拆分，与 §13.16 的 1c 起点关法相同。§13.16 的 2a/2b 配对还保留第一遍边界背景。原三场景沿用旧区域掩码和 F2，按当前检查点重新定焦并构建环带 Query；新开发集使用 v2 LDR 参考。按开、关各自的 RGB SSE 和像素数合并求 PSNR，再相减；仅作诊断。
